passage.text: Nam and Emma are cooking pad kra pao in Emma's kitchen.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ənd ˈɛmə ər ˈkʊkɪŋ ˌpɑːd krə ˈpaʊ ɪn ˈɛməz ˈkɪtʃən.

passage.text: First, Nam heats some oil in a pan.
passage.reading: ˈfɜːrst, ˈnɑːm ˈhiːts sʌm ˈɔɪl ɪn ə ˈpæn.

passage.text: "Now add the garlic and the chilies, and stir quickly," she says.
passage.reading: "ˈnaʊ ˈæd ðə ˈɡɑːrlɪk ənd ðə ˈtʃɪliz, ənd ˈstɜːr ˈkwɪkli," ʃiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: Emma stirs, but a minute later, she says, "Oh no! I think I burned the garlic!"
passage.reading: ˈɛmə ˈstɜːrz, bʌt ə ˈmɪnɪt ˈleɪtər, ʃiː ˈsɛz, "ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! aɪ ˈθɪŋk aɪ ˈbɜːrnd ðə ˈɡɑːrlɪk!"

passage.text: Nam laughs and says, "It's OK. Only a little is black."
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ˈlæfs ənd ˈsɛz, "ɪts oʊˈkeɪ. ˈoʊnli ə ˈlɪtəl ɪz ˈblæk."

passage.text: Then they add the chicken, some fish sauce and a little sugar.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ðeɪ ˈæd ðə ˈtʃɪkən, sʌm ˈfɪʃ ˌsɔːs ənd ə ˈlɪtəl ˈʃʊɡər.

passage.text: Emma tastes it and says, "It's spicy, but it's delicious!"
passage.reading: ˈɛmə ˈteɪsts ɪt ənd ˈsɛz, "ɪts ˈspaɪsi, bʌt ɪts dɪˈlɪʃəs!"

passage.text: Finally, Nam adds the basil, and they eat it with rice and an egg.
passage.reading: ˈfaɪnəli, ˈnɑːm ˈædz ðə ˈbeɪzəl, ənd ðeɪ ˈiːt ɪt wɪð ˈraɪs ənd ən ˈɛɡ.
